subject: What? It doesn't save the best time???
author: Xandu
body:
That is just amazing! What is the point of Time Trial if it doesn't save your best time??? With all the bugs you have found Jasman there should be more than enough to justify a patch. But we all know that it's not going to happen... and if it does happen we will probably never know what it fixes.

-- BurnoutAholics.com admin --

subject: Getting there
author: Xandu
body:
As the Avril Lavigne music track in Burnout Dominator is seriously getting on our nerves I decided to totally disable it in both menu and game... but guess what??? After a reboot of the PSP it was back... arghhhhhh! Anyway... I've disabled it again and hopefully it will be gone forever now.

ohhhh and I've completed 86% of the game now. Only missing gold in six events and about 10 sig-shortcuts... and a couple of the trophies.

-- BurnoutAholics.com admin --
